_note: 學習路徑內容建置第7批 #3／6：現在進行式表未來 present progressive for future（eng.t_mid.verb.present-prog-future，會考級／中階）。be + V-ing 可表示『已經排定、約好的未來計畫』，通常帶明確未來時間（tomorrow at six、next week）。因現在進行表未來與 be going to 語意高度重疊，刻意不以 be going to 當誘答（避免第二正解），改以『缺 be／錯形式／錯時態』與『時間詞辨識』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ppfut_）。

units.title_zh: 現在進行式表未來（已排定的計畫）
units.can_do: 我能用現在進行式（am／is／are ＋ V-ing）表達「已經排定、約好」的未來計畫，知道這通常帶明確的未來時間（如 tomorrow at six），並能靠時間詞判斷句子是講「現在」還是「未來」。
units.situation_group: 未來式 Talking about the future
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Use the present progressive (be + verb-ing) for a fixed future arrangement or plan: I'm meeting Jane at six tomorrow.
claims.verification_ref: 現在進行式表已排定的未來計畫；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A future time expression (tomorrow, next week, at six) shows that a present-progressive sentence is about the future, not about now.
claims.verification_ref: 未來時間詞標示現在進行表未來而非當下；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The form is am/is/are + verb-ing: We're having dinner with them on Friday.
claims.verification_ref: 形式＝am/is/are ＋ V-ing；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: This future use is common for arrangements that are already settled, often with other people and a set time or place: She's flying to London on Monday.
claims.verification_ref: 常用於已確定、涉及他人/定時定點的安排；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The same present-progressive form can mean 'happening now' or 'a future arrangement'; the time expression tells you which: Right now I'm studying (now) vs Tonight I'm watching a movie (future).
claims.verification_ref: 同一形式可指當下或未來，由時間詞判別；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The present progressive (am/is/are + V-ing) can also talk about the future, not just what is happening now. We use it for plans that are already arranged: you have fixed a time or booked a ticket, so it is not a sudden idea.
teach.zh_hint: 現在進行式（am／is／are ＋ V-ing）除了講「現在正在做」，還能講「已經排定、約好」的未來計畫。重點是這件事已經安排好了（約好時間、訂好票），不是臨時想到。

teach.body: I'm meeting my cousins at the train station tomorrow at noon.
teach.zh_hint: 我明天中午要在火車站跟表親碰面。已約好——現在進行表未來。

teach.body: This future use often comes with a clear future time (tomorrow, next week, at six), and usually it is an arrangement you have made with someone, with a set time and place.
teach.zh_hint: 這種用法常帶明確的未來時間（tomorrow、next week、at six），也常是和別人約好、定了時間地點的安排。

teach.body: We're flying to Osaka next week; we already booked the tickets.
teach.zh_hint: 我們下週要飛大阪，票都訂好了。已安排的計畫。

teach.body: The same form can mean 'now' or 'the future' — the time words tell you which. 'right now' and 'at the moment' mean now; 'tomorrow', 'tonight' and 'next week' mean the future.
teach.zh_hint: 同樣的形式，有時講「現在」、有時講「未來」——看時間詞就知道。right now／at the moment＝現在；tomorrow／tonight／next week＝未來。

teach.body: Right now I'm studying, and tonight I'm watching a movie with my family.
teach.zh_hint: 我現在在唸書，今晚要跟家人看電影。right now＝現在、tonight＝未來。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（已約好的計畫）：We ____ dinner with Grandma this Saturday evening—she already invited us.（我們這週六晚上要跟奶奶吃飯，她已經邀我們了）

distractor_rationales.have: 現在簡單式 have 用在習慣或時刻表；已經約好的私人計畫用現在進行式 are having。
distractor_rationales.having: 少了 be 動詞（應是 are having）。
distractor_rationales.are had: are had 是被動/錯誤形式；現在進行式用 are ＋ V-ing＝are having。

practice.feedback: 已約好的未來計畫用現在進行式：We are having dinner with Grandma this Saturday evening。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（已訂好機票）：She ____ to London next Monday; her flight is already booked.（她下週一要飛倫敦，機票已經訂好了）

distractor_rationales.flies: 現在簡單式 flies 講習慣或時刻表；已訂好的個人行程用現在進行式 is flying。
distractor_rationales.is fly: is 後面要接 V-ing（flying），不是原形 fly。
distractor_rationales.flew: flew 是過去式，講過去的事；這裡是已安排的未來，用 is flying。

practice.feedback: 已安排好的未來行程用現在進行式：She is flying to London next Monday。

practice.stem: 哪一個時間詞讓這句現在進行式是在講「未來的計畫」？　"I'm playing tennis ____."

distractor_rationales.right now: right now＝此刻，表示「現在正在做」，不是未來計畫。
distractor_rationales.at the moment: at the moment＝此刻，表示「現在正在做」，不是未來計畫。
distractor_rationales.these days: these days＝最近這陣子（現在的一段時間），不是指某個未來的計畫。

practice.feedback: 未來時間詞 tomorrow afternoon 讓現在進行式變成在講未來的計畫：I'm playing tennis tomorrow afternoon。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（已約好，一小時後）：My brother ____ his friends at the station in an hour.（我哥一小時後要在車站跟朋友碰面）

distractor_rationales.meets: 現在簡單式 meets 講習慣；已約好、一小時後的安排用現在進行式 is meeting。
distractor_rationales.meet: 主詞 My brother 是第三人稱，且要用現在進行式；用 is meeting。
distractor_rationales.is met: is met 是被動；他是主動去碰面，用 is meeting。

practice.feedback: 已約好的未來安排用現在進行式：My brother is meeting his friends at the station in an hour。

practice.stem: 選出正確用「現在進行式表未來計畫」的句子（明天一早出發去機場，已安排好）：
practice.answer: We're leaving for the airport at six tomorrow morning.
options: We're leaving for the airport at six tomorrow morning.
We leaving for the airport at six tomorrow morning.
We're leave for the airport at six tomorrow morning.
We are left for the airport at six tomorrow morning.

distractor_rationales.We leaving for the airport at six tomorr: 少了 be 動詞（應是 We're / We are leaving）。
distractor_rationales.We're leave for the airport at six tomor: are 後面要接 V-ing（leaving），不是原形 leave。
distractor_rationales.We are left for the airport at six tomor: are left 是被動；我們是主動出發，用 are leaving。

practice.feedback: 現在進行式表未來計畫：We're leaving for the airport at six tomorrow morning。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We're having a picnic in the park this Sunday, so please don't forget to bring your hat.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：We're having（現在進行表未來）有沒有寫對、this Sunday 有沒有漏，don't forget／hat 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。be 動詞常縮讀（I'm、They're），V-ing 唸清楚，未來時間詞稍強調，句尾下收。

lines.text: I'm visiting my grandparents next weekend.
lines.intonation: I'm 輕讀、next weekend 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: They're moving to a new house at the end of the month.
lines.intonation: They're 輕讀、new house 稍強調、句尾下收
